## What this site is

First-party pages about Mesa at Skyeview (single-family, one-story new construction in Skye Canyon) and Dr. Jan Duffy’s realtor services. MLS search runs through RealScout. Appointments run through Calendly on the contact page. Do not invent prices, rankings, review counts, or school-quality claims.

## Facts (verify live MLS before quoting a price)

- Homes: one-story plans, about 1,635–1,816 sq ft, 2–3 bedrooms
- Public listings often show pricing from the mid-$400s — ask Dr. Jan for current MLS and builder inventory
- ZIP: 89166 (Northwest Las Vegas / Skye Canyon)
- Builder sales teams represent the builder; register Dr. Jan before the first model visit to keep buyer representation
